paragraphs: Arcanist es un servidor de streaming personal: sirve para escuchar, en tus dispositivos y con quien tú decidas, la música de tu propia colección.
Arcanist promueve comprar música, en formato digital o en discos físicos, para importarla y que forme parte de tu colección. No tiene ni busca ningún propósito fuera de la ley.

The only way to leave evidence of a bug is to open an issue in the project's public repository: {issuesUrl}. Opening one creates no obligation to answer or fix it.

paragraphs: Except for LinkFast S.A.'s service, claims about how an Arcanist installation works, its availability or its use cannot be made against LinkFast S.A.: they belong to whoever administers it.

disclaimer.title: A personal music server
paragraphs: Arcanist is a personal streaming server: it is for listening to the music of your own collection, on your devices and with whoever you choose.
Arcanist encourages buying music, as digital files or on physical records, to import it into your collection. It has and seeks no purpose outside the law.

paragraphs: LinkFast S.A. does not store works protected by intellectual property nor makes them available to anyone: the music, its files and its rights are the user's, who decides what to keep and whom to share it with.

disclaimer.title: Sharing
paragraphs: If you share your library with other people or servers, letting them listen to it (streaming) or download it, you must hold whatever permissions or licenses doing so requires in each case.

paragraphs: You are responsible for using Arcanist in accordance with the law and the rights of the music's authors and rights holders. LinkFast S.A. does not encourage or support any use that infringes them.
